pages.title: Kilonovae
pages.text: $(thing)Kilonovae$()$(br2)When two neutron stars merge, a few hundredths of a solar mass of neutron-rich matter is flung out, and in a second it captures neutrons up to gold and platinum. Its radioactive glow fades over days.
$(thing)Insight$(): 170$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Compact Stars, Nuclear Astrophysics.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 2 Neutron Star Merger Record, 2 Deep Sky Plate.
